/* ==================== 0. DANH SÁCH GIÁO VIÊN CẦN THỐNG KÊ ==================== */
	Select
		SIM_Teacher.TeacherID,
		SIM_Teacher.TeacherFirstName,
		SIM_Teacher.TeacherLastName,
		SIM_Teacher.TeacherFirstName + ' ' + SIM_Teacher.TeacherLastName As TeacherName
	Into #tblTeacherList
	From SIM_Teacher

/* ==================== 3. GIỜ CÔNG VIỆC: HỌC TẬP, BỒI DƯỠNG / HOẠT ĐỘNG KHÁC ==================== */
	-- Áp dụng ngưỡng (cap):
	--   Khoa <> 'DTLX': HTBD=26, HDKhac=52
	--   Khoa = 'DTLX': HTBD=26, HDKhac=26
	Select
		#tblTeacherList.TeacherID,
		Cast(Case
			When IsNull(Sum(Case When SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.TeacherWorkID = 34 Then SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.TotalFinal Else 0 End), 0) > 26
			Then 26
			Else IsNull(Sum(Case When SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.TeacherWorkID = 34 Then SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.TotalFinal Else 0 End), 0)
		End As Decimal(18,2)) As TotalFinal_W34_HocTapBoiDuong,
		Cast(Case
			When Max(#tblTeacherList.ScienceID) <> 'DTLX'
				And IsNull(Sum(Case When SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.TeacherWorkID = 35 Then SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.TotalFinal Else 0 End), 0) > 52
			Then 52
			When Max(#tblTeacherList.ScienceID) = 'DTLX'
				And IsNull(Sum(Case When SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.TeacherWorkID = 35 Then SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.TotalFinal Else 0 End), 0) > 26
			Then 26
			Else IsNull(Sum(Case When SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.TeacherWorkID = 35 Then SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.TotalFinal Else 0 End), 0)
		End As Decimal(18,2)) As TotalFinal_W35_HoatDongKhac
	Into #tbl_Gio_CV_HD
	From #tblTeacherList
	Left Join SIM_TeachingTimeAdded On SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.TeacherID = #tblTeacherList.TeacherID
		And SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.YearID = @YearID
		And SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.Semester = @Semester
	Group By #tblTeacherList.TeacherID;

   - `TotalFinal_W35_HoatDongKhac`: cap tại **52** cho khoa <> 'DTLX', cap tại **26** cho khoa = 'DTLX'
